name: Systematic Review / Meta-analysis
description: PRISMA-oriented systematic review and meta-analysis workflow: 00_literature evidence review/topic selection, protocol/PICO, database search, dedupe and screening, Zotero handoff for missing full text, MinerU/direct conversion, extraction tables, risk-of-bias appraisal, pooled statistics, forest/funnel/PRISMA figures, manuscript and submission package. New project artifacts should use the meta-v2 numbered folders, not MetaAnalysis/ or generic Experiment/analysis Meta outputs.

metaFields.label: Target venue
metaFields.placeholder: Journal, preprint, thesis, or internal report

metaFields.label: Review type
metaFields.placeholder: systematic review | meta-analysis | diagnostic meta-analysis | network meta-analysis | scoping review

metaFields.label: Registration / protocol reference
metaFields.placeholder: Optional: PROSPERO / OSF / protocol DOI. If unavailable, write registration guidance only.

literature.label: Primary review question
literature.placeholder: Population, exposure/intervention/index test, comparator, and outcomes

literature.label: Evidence scope
literature.placeholder: Databases, years, languages, study designs, and topic boundary

literature.label: Eligibility criteria
literature.placeholder: Inclusion and exclusion criteria for title/abstract and full-text screening

literature.label: Seed references
literature.placeholder: One seed paper, guideline, or prior review per line

literature.label: Current evidence summary
literature.placeholder: What is known, uncertain, and why quantitative synthesis is justified

literature.label: Reporting / evidence requirements
literature.placeholder: PRISMA, MOOSE, STARD, Cochrane, GRADE, trial registry checks, etc.

literature.label: Meta topic selection
literature.placeholder: Scientific relevance, evidence volume, heterogeneity risk, extractable effect sizes, feasibility, and submission value

literature.label: Scoping / systematic review route
literature.placeholder: Evidence mapping, narrative synthesis, or quantitative Meta-analysis route decision

ideation.label: Review objective
ideation.placeholder: Primary objective and intended decision value

ideation.label: Protocol framing
ideation.placeholder: Review type, target population, study design scope, and expected synthesis family

ideation.label: Search and evidence plan
ideation.placeholder: PubMed, Embase/Web of Science if available, OpenAlex, trial registries, gray literature, citation chasing

ideation.label: Success criteria
ideation.placeholder: One criterion per line, e.g. reproducible search log, complete PRISMA counts, meta-ready extraction table

experiment.label: Primary synthesis target
experiment.placeholder: Primary outcome and effect measure, e.g. OR/RR/MD/SMD/HR/DOR/prevalence

experiment.label: Reference and full-text sources
experiment.placeholder: Search export files, Zotero collection, References/, included_references.csv, existing PDF/Markdown/HTML/text assets

experiment.label: Screening / extraction / quality protocol
experiment.placeholder: Screening rules, Claude reviewer pass, extraction fields, RoB tool, GRADE plan, conflict handling

experiment.label: Meta-analysis plan
experiment.placeholder: Fixed/random effects, heterogeneity estimator, subgroup/sensitivity, publication bias

experiment.label: Sensitivity analyses
experiment.placeholder: One sensitivity or subgroup analysis per line

publication.label: PRISMA manuscript outline
publication.placeholder: Abstract, introduction, methods, results, discussion, limitations, conclusion

publication.label: Figures / tables plan
publication.placeholder: PRISMA flow, study characteristics, RoB, forest, funnel, subgroup/sensitivity, GRADE

publication.label: Reproducibility artifact plan
publication.placeholder: Search logs, extraction sheets, analysis scripts, figure exports, supplementary files

publication.label: Submission checklist
publication.placeholder: PRISMA checklist, data availability, conflicts, funding, protocol registration, supplements

promotion.label: Slide outline
promotion.placeholder: Question, PRISMA flow, evidence map, main pooled result, limitations, implication

promotion.label: Deck style
promotion.placeholder: Journal club, conference, or lab meeting style

promotion.label: Public summary plan
promotion.placeholder: Plain-language summary and artifact links, if needed

quality_gate: The review question is specific enough to drive search and screening
Eligibility criteria can be applied consistently
Prior evidence, topic feasibility, and any scoping-review route decision are stated concretely
Project startup and pipeline bootstrap reports, when produced, are saved under 01_protocol/project_startup_report.md or a timestamped variant.
If evidence is insufficient for the requested route, write a feasibility or no-data report instead of inventing records.

task_blueprints.title: Run literature review and Meta topic feasibility check
task_blueprints.description: Create 00_literature/ artifacts for evidence summary, seed references, open gaps, candidate PICO/PECO, topic feasibility, and scoping/systematic review route. Do not write locked protocol files until the topic is selected.

task_blueprints.title: Build search strategy and seed evidence map
task_blueprints.description: After the 00_literature route is selected, draft PubMed/MEDLINE and optional OpenAlex or registry search plans, record formal search logs, and define the search log format under 02_search_dedupe/.

quality_gate: The protocol framing states the synthesis family and expected evidence limits
Search and screening can proceed without changing the primary question
Success criteria define reproducible artifacts, not only narrative goals
Project startup and task-queue reports are saved under 01_protocol/project_startup_report.md or a timestamped variant.
Human review confirms the selected review route before downstream automation proceeds.

task_blueprints.title: Write Meta project startup report and skill-routed task queue
task_blueprints.description: Use meta-pipeline-planner first and meta-analysis-workflow for cross-stage orchestration. Summarize current stage, missing artifacts, selected or pending review type, human review gates, and the skill list for each automatic step. Save the startup or task-queue report under 01_protocol/project_startup_report.md or a timestamped variant.

task_blueprints.title: Lock protocol decisions and output directory contract
task_blueprints.description: Convert the selected 00_literature topic into locked review objective, synthesis family, screening phases, artifact locations under the numbered Meta folders, and 01_protocol/workflow_status.md update rules.

task_blueprints.title: Generate executable task queue for search through manuscript
task_blueprints.description: Convert the protocol into ordered tasks for 02_search_dedupe/ search/dedupe, 03_title_abstract_screening/ screening, 04_full_text_review/ Zotero missing-full-text handoff and MinerU/direct-conversion work, 05_data_extraction/ extraction, 06_quality_assessment/ appraisal, 07_data_analysis/ statistics, 08_results_figures/ figures, and 09_manuscript_submission/ writing. Save the startup or task-queue report under 01_protocol/project_startup_report.md or a timestamped variant.

quality_gate: Title/abstract screening records first-screen files under 03_title_abstract_screening/01_ai_pre_screen/, named Claude second-screen files/conflicts under 03_title_abstract_screening/02_agent_rescreen/, plus synchronized stage=title_abstract records in 03_title_abstract_screening/screening_decisions.json

Named-agent-reviewed title/abstract include/maybe records, plus explicit user overrides, are eligible for a missing-full-text queue, but only incomplete records written to fulltext_manifest.json/csv with needs_full_text=true are pushed to Zotero; two human reviewers are not required
Run lawful public/user-owned full-text download/acquisition on the explicit fulltext_manifest queue before Zotero handoff; only records that remain incomplete are pushed to Zotero

Full-text screening repeats first-screen and second-screen passes after Zotero attachments are synced back with synchronized stage=full_text records in 03_title_abstract_screening/screening_decisions.json, while full-text assets, parse outputs, unavailable lists, and concise audit logs stay under 04_full_text_review/ or 04_full_text_review/fulltext/ without 01_ai_pre_screen/ or 02_agent_rescreen/ subfolders
Missing full text is pushed to Zotero for PDF retrieval/attachment and records handoff/sync status
MinerU parse outputs carry quality flags and escalate only low-quality or conflicted records for user confirmation
Extraction, quality appraisal, and meta-analysis inputs are source-linked and reviewable by Claude plus the user
Never invent full text, extraction values, quality ratings, or statistical inputs; write the appropriate cannot-extract report when blocked.
Human review checks extraction, quality, and synthesis gates before statistics or claims proceed.
Any code is stored under the relevant numbered stage code/ subfolder.

task_blueprints.title: Run search normalization, dedupe, and title/abstract first/second screening
task_blueprints.description: Create 02_search_dedupe/ and 03_title_abstract_screening/ artifacts including raw search results, deduped records, title/abstract first-screen scores under 03_title_abstract_screening/01_ai_pre_screen/, a named Claude second-screen review under 03_title_abstract_screening/02_agent_rescreen/, inclusion/exclusion rubric, suspected false include/exclude flags, explicit user overrides if any, included_references.csv, and PRISMA counts. Also write/update 03_title_abstract_screening/screening_decisions.json using schemaVersion meta-screening-v1 and stage=title_abstract so the intelligent screening page can sync the records; Markdown is explanatory only.

task_blueprints.title: Download lawful full text, hand remaining missing items to Zotero, then run full-text screening
task_blueprints.description: Use title/abstract Claude-reviewed include/maybe records plus explicit user overrides only as eligibility, then create/update fulltext_manifest.json/csv records with needs_full_text=true for incomplete full text. First use legal full-text acquisition/download from existing project assets, user uploads, PMC/OA, and other documented public sources, recording downloaded/exists/manual_upload_required/no_oa_pdf/failed status. Push only records that remain incomplete to Zotero for PDF retrieval/attachment. Record unavailable items and Zotero handoff/sync status, then repeat first-screen/second-screen review for full text by writing/updating 03_title_abstract_screening/screening_decisions.json with stage=full_text and keeping full-text audit logs under 04_full_text_review/. Hand synced records to MinerU/direct conversion under 04_full_text_review/ without creating 01_ai_pre_screen/ or 02_agent_rescreen/ subfolders.

task_blueprints.title: Build extraction and quality appraisal tables
task_blueprints.description: After Zotero-synced full texts pass quality triage, create candidate study characteristics, outcome extraction, and effect-size input under 05_data_extraction/; keep risk-of-bias and GRADE/quality notes under 06_quality_assessment/ with source evidence, confidence, and Claude review flags. Candidate extraction rows must be user-authorized or confirmed before statistics.

task_blueprints.title: Run pooled statistics and generate core figures
task_blueprints.description: Prepare meta_input.csv only from user-authorized or confirmed extraction rows, run the selected synthesis model, and export results.json under 07_data_analysis/; generate forest, funnel, subgroup/sensitivity, PRISMA figures, and result tables under 08_results_figures/.

quality_gate: PRISMA reporting items are mapped to real artifacts
Methods, results, figures, and references agree with extraction/statistics outputs
Unavailable full-text or non-OA items are handled transparently
Human review checks PRISMA compliance, references, and data availability before submission files are finalized.
Any manuscript automation code is stored under 09_manuscript_submission/code/.

task_blueprints.title: Draft PRISMA manuscript and supplementary package
task_blueprints.description: Write manuscript.md/DOCX-ready text, PRISMA checklist, supplements, search appendix, data availability notes, methods details, and limitations under 09_manuscript_submission/.

task_blueprints.title: Audit PRISMA compliance, references, and reproducibility artifacts
task_blueprints.description: Run a peer-review style check across search log, PRISMA counts, extraction tables, analysis outputs, figures, references, and submission checklist.

quality_gate: Presentation materials preserve the review question, PRISMA flow, main pooled results, and evidence certainty
Claims do not exceed the certainty of evidence
Human review checks public-facing claims against evidence certainty before release.
Any presentation or homepage code is stored under 10_presentation/code/.

task_blueprints.title: Build presentation storyline from the PRISMA manuscript
task_blueprints.description: Create a concise slide flow covering question, methods, PRISMA flow, evidence profile, pooled effects, limitations, and implication under 10_presentation/.

task_blueprints.title: Prepare figures and delivery assets
task_blueprints.description: Package forest/funnel/PRISMA figures from 08_results_figures/ and optional public summary assets for talks, journal club, or project page under 10_presentation/.
